required_evidence.rule: cited coauthorIds are a subset of expected.coauthors; returnedCount equals min(total, page_limit)

questions.question: What is the shortest coauthor path between "Hucheng Zhou" and "Xuepeng Fan"?

required_evidence.rule: every cited path's ids are a real path in the window graph with hopCount == hops, first id a and last id b

required_text.note: the hop count appears as a digit or word; for 2 or more hops the interior names of at least one shortest path appear

questions.question: What is the component of "Kunal Talwar"?
